result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but several horizontally scrolling elements are hard-clipped at the right and bottom edges, making content look cropped rather than intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped at the right edge: the third card image is half off-screen and the restaurant name is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol...', which can read as broken rather than a scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance such as peek spacing consistent on both sides, a page indicator, or fade/arrow; avoid truncating the visible card title so aggressively.

issues.description: The category chip row has a partially visible pill cut off at the far right edge after 'Healthy' with no fade or arrow.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade, scroll indicator, or more symmetric inset so the cut-off chip reads as intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: The lower 'Popular right now' pizza card is cropped by the bottom of the viewport and overlaps close to the fixed bottom navigation, leaving an awkward partial card visible.
issues.suggestion: Increase bottom content padding above the tab bar and use a consistent card peek height so partially visible content looks deliberate.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and time are small gray text, which may be low contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase text size/contrast for metadata to meet WCAG AA while preserving hierarchy.
